description.value: Indian Wok is an Indian-Chinese fusion restaurant specialising in Hakka cuisine — a style blending South Asian spice profiles with Chinese cooking techniques that is popular in the South Asian diaspora. The menu spans appetisers, soups, noodles, and mains across a wide spice range, with a generous selection of vegetarian and tofu-based dishes. It sits on Kingsway in Burnaby, a commercial arterial road that connects several inner-suburb cycling routes.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (5 spaces) at 84m; stands (5 spaces) at 95m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at indianwok.ca is live and shows a full menu, confirming the business is operating. The website address (5212 Kingsway Ave. Burnaby) contradicts the OSM tag (5122 Kingsway), and the URL discovery notes independently flag this same discrepancy — the OSM housenumber appears to be a typo. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site; takeout is confirmed by explicit pickup promotion and three delivery platform integrations; vegetarian options are confirmed by numerous explicitly labelled vegetarian dishes.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM housenumber is 5122 Kingsway but the business website clearly states 5212 Kingsway Ave. Burnaby — OSM tag appears to be a transposition typo. URL discovery notes independently flag the same discrepancy.
No phone number visible on the website; OSM phone +1-604-428-2673 could not be cross-confirmed.
No bike parking, washrooms, or water refill information found on website or in OSM tags — core WWC required criteria are all unverified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is clearly operating and offers takeout with vegetarian options suitable for touring cyclists, but the address discrepancy (OSM: 5122 Kingsway vs. website: 5212 Kingsway) must be resolved before publishing, and no bike-specific amenities (parking, water, washrooms) are confirmed.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Multiple explicitly labelled vegetarian dishes including Calcutta Vegetarian Hakka Chow Mein, Vegetarian Spring Roll, Vegetable Pakora, Chili Garlic Vegetarian Dumplings, and a full Tofu & Paneer section
